findings.reason: Confirmed (high). The item states that 'if X_0 is flat and finitely presented over a valuation ring V (here of rank 1), then O_{X_0} is locally a free V-module'. That is false. For a rank-one V with nonzero t in its maximal ideal, Spec V[1/t] = Spec Frac(V) is flat and finitely presented over V, but Frac(V) is not a free V-module: its reduction mod t is 0. The paper uses this only for its proper, flat, reduced model: 'let f₀ : X₀ → Spec(V) be a proper flat reduced model of f' (arXiv v3, p. 26, proof of Theorem 6.13). There it cites [RG71, Corollaire 3.3.13], a pointed statement over a local henselian base. V is henselian here because its fraction field has been made algebraically closed. Properness spreads the closed-fibre neighbourhoods over all of X₀. The fix is right: state the proper, henselian form and keep the route.
